Question: What percentage of films are made in the US?
Knowledge: films' and 'movies' are synonyms; made in the US refers to country_iso_code = 'US'; percentage = divide(sum(country_id) when country_iso_code = 'US', count(country_id)) * 100 as percentage
SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.COUNTry_iso_code = 'US' THEN T1.movie_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.movie_id) FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN production_COUNTry AS T2 ON T1.movie_id = T2.movie_id INNER JOIN COUNTry AS T3 ON T2.COUNTry_id = T3.COUNTry_id

roysched(title_id TEXT, lorange INTEGER, hirange INTEGER, royalty INTEGER)
Question: Find the difference between the average royalty of titles published by US and non US publishers?
Knowledge: US publisher refers publisher in the US where country = 'USA'; non-US publishers refers publisher not in the US where country! = 'USA'; difference = SUBTRACT(AVG(royalty) where country = 'USA', AVG(royalty) where country! = 'USA'))
SQL: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country = 'USA' THEN T1.royalty ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) - (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country != 'USA' THEN T1.royalty ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country != 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) FROM titles AS T1 INNER JOIN publishers AS T2 ON T1.pub_id = T2.pub_id INNER JOIN roysched AS T3 ON T1.title_id = T3.title_id

Schema: Recipe(recipe_id INTEGER, title TEXT, subtitle TEXT, servings INTEGER, yield_unit TEXT, prep_min INTEGER, cook_min INTEGER, stnd_min INTEGER, source TEXT, intro TEXT, directions TEXT)

Question: What are the optional ingredients for Warm Chinese Chicken Salad?
Knowledge: optional refers to optional = 'TRUE'; Warm Chinese Chicken Salad refers to title
SQL: SELECT T3.name FROM Recipe AS T1 INNER JOIN Quantity AS T2 ON T1.recipe_id = T2.recipe_id INNER JOIN Ingredient AS T3 ON T3.ingredient_id = T2.ingredient_id WHERE T1.title = 'Warm Chinese Chicken Salad' AND T2.optional = 'TRUE'
Example 2

SQL: SELECT T1.name FROM Ingredient AS T1 INNER JOIN Quantity AS T2 ON T1.ingredient_id = T2.ingredient_id WHERE T2.recipe_id = 1397 AND T2.optional = 'TRUE'

Schema: coins(id INTEGER, name TEXT, slug TEXT, symbol TEXT, status TEXT, category TEXT, description TEXT, subreddit TEXT, notice TEXT, tags TEXT, tag_names TEXT, website TEXT, platform_id INTEGER, date_added TEXT, date_launched TEXT)

Question: What is the name of the coin with the highest price?
Knowledge: the highest price refers to max(price)
SQL: SELECT T1.name FROM coins AS T1 INNER JOIN historical AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.coin_id WHERE T2.price = ( SELECT MAX(price) FROM historical )

### Question
What is the percentage of application with 4.7 rating having more positives sentiment than negative sentiment?


Question: Which product ID do not have any work order ID?
Knowledge: Do not have any work order ID means WorkOrderID is null
SQL: SELECT ProductID FROM Product WHERE ProductID NOT IN ( SELECT T1.ProductID FROM Product AS T1 INNER JOIN WorkOrder AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID )

Question: What is the average number of characters in all the works of Shakespeare?
Knowledge: average number = divide(sum(character_id), count(work_id))
SQL: SELECT SUM(DISTINCT T4.id) / COUNT(T1.id) FROM works AS T1 INNER JOIN chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN paragraphs AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id INNER JOIN characters AS T4 ON T3.character_id = T4.id
